name: production boundary: netlify status | xargs -I{} echo {} reads like every other xargs option and is denied unread

source.assertion:
assert_equals "a deploy CLI that only feeds xargs is none of that rule's business" \
  "allow allow allow" \
  "$(prod_verdicts_for 'vercel ls | xargs echo' 'netlify status | xargs -I{} echo {}' \
    'find . -name *.log | xargs rm')"

contains: past what the production boundary can read
